The Offer

Your video podcast, edited under your brand: the full episode plus 5 vertical clips, delivered in 3 business days (48-hour priority available at +25%). Start with a paid pilot episode for $295, credited against your first month if you sign within 14 days. Monthly plans: Starter $1,049 for 4 episodes, Growth $1,899 for 8 episodes, Scale $3,499 for 16 episodes.

Invisible by Design

We work behind your brand. Your clients never see our name, and you keep the margin.

Fast, Reliable Turnaround

Standard turnaround is 3 business days, with 48-hour priority available for +25%. We regularly deliver the Big Technology Podcast’s episodes and Shorts on tight deadlines, sometimes in under 24 hours.

How It Works

Send raw files and your brand guide. We match your style on episode one, you give notes, and from there it’s plug-and-play. Need more volume? Our team scales with you.

Who We Edit For

“Nobody does it better than Superblexy! Great team, quality work, and fun times always.” — Alex Kantrowitz, host of the Big Technology Podcast. We also edit for Sebastian De Castro, The Black Wealth Explainer, Indiewalls and Marketing32.
